title: Quassinoids from Malaysian Eurycoma longifolia significantly increased the expression of the melatonin biosynthesis-related enzyme gene (AANAT)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16947-16954
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01703C, Paper

Three representative C20-quassinoids (1–3) isolated from Eurycoma longifolia roots significantly upregulated AANAT, a key gene in melatonin biosynthesis, compared to the control.
